title: Debiased Distillation by Transplanting the Last Layer

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy on the CelebA dataset (correlating hair color with male/female gender) and the CivilComments dataset (correlating toxicity with gender identities).
Evaluating worst-group accuracy on the CivilComments dataset for toxicity classification across comments containing various demographic identities, including LGBT, ethnicity, religion, and race.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset across subgroups defined by the target object (bird species) and spuriously correlated background landscapes (water vs. land).
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the MultiNLI dataset across subgroups defined by sentence logical relationships and the spuriously correlated presence of negation words.
